1260: InFlowBC_Supersonic = BoundaryCondition:new()
1261: InFlowBC_Supersonic.type = "inflow_supersonic"
1262: function InFlowBC_Supersonic:new(o)
1263:    local flag = type(self)=='table' and self.type=='inflow_supersonic'
1264:    if not flag then
1265:       error("Make sure that you are using InFlowBC_Supersonic:new{}"..
1266:                " and not InFlowBC_Supersonic.new{}", 2)
1267:    end
1268:    o = o or {}
1269:    flag = checkAllowedNames(o, {"flowState", "flowCondition", "x0", "y0", "z0", "r", "label", "group","field_bc"})
1270:    if not flag then
1271:       error("Invalid name for item supplied to InFlowBC_Supersonic constructor.", 2)
1272:    end
1273:    if o.flowState == nil then o.flowState = o.flowCondition end -- look for old name
1274:    -- Look for conical-flow parameters.
1275:    o.x0 = o.x0 or 0.0
1276:    o.y0 = o.y0 or 0.0
1277:    o.z0 = o.z0 or 0.0
1278:    o.r = o.r or 0.0
1279:    -- Configure parameters and actions.
1280:    o = BoundaryCondition.new(self, o)
1281:    o.is_wall_with_viscous_effects = false
1282:    o.preReconAction = {
1283:       FlowStateCopy:new{flowState=o.flowState, x0=o.x0, y0=o.y0, z0=o.z0, r=o.r}
1284:    }
1285:    o.preSpatialDerivActionAtBndryFaces = {
1286:       FlowStateCopyToInterface:new{flowState=o.flowState, x0=o.x0, y0=o.y0, z0=o.z0, r=o.r}
1287:    }
1288:    o.is_configured = true
1289:    return o
1290: end
